scope: local static and CLI checks only; no torch or NPU worker imported

checks.stdout:
usage: hccl_eager_backend_probe.py [-h] --operation {isend,irecv}
                                   [--devices DEVICES] [--model MODEL]
                                   --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                                   [--gate-window GATE_WINDOW]
                                   [--timeout TIMEOUT]

Opt-in host-posting/Work dependency gate on the existing HCCL data group. The
supervisor withholds the matcher's CPU permission to enter its data op.
Posting return, Work.wait return, pending consumer event and exact payload are
separate observations. This is an endpoint capability gate, without a parent
plan, model weights, eager tickets, HCCL abort or device recovery acceptance.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --operation {isend,irecv}
  --devices DEVICES     FFN then Attention
  --model MODEL         config only
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --gate-window GATE_WINDOW
  --timeout TIMEOUT
